title: Elden Ring - Overview
content: Elden Ring is an action role-playing game developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Set in the Lands Between, players assume the role of a Tarnished, a being who has been exiled from the Lands Between and must return to claim the Elden Ring and become the Elden Lord.

title: The Lands Between
content: The Lands Between is a vast open world filled with diverse landscapes, from lush forests and towering castles to desolate wastelands and mystical ruins. It was once ruled by Queen Marika the Eternal, who shattered the Elden Ring, causing a great divide among the demigods who now war over its shards.

title: The Elden Ring
content: The Elden Ring is a powerful artifact that governs the laws of the Lands Between. When Queen Marika shattered it, the resulting shards, known as Great Runes, were claimed by her demigod children. To restore the Elden Ring and become the Elden Lord, the Tarnished must collect these Great Runes and defeat the demigods who possess them.

title: Demigods
content: The demigods are the children of Queen Marika and other divine beings. Key demigods include Godrick the Grafted, Rennala Queen of the Full Moon, Radahn the Starscourge, Rykard Lord of Blasphemy, Morgott the Omen King, and Malenia Blade of Miquella. Each guards a Great Rune and presents a significant challenge to the Tarnished.

title: Godrick the Grafted
content: Godrick the Grafted is the first major boss players encounter in Elden Ring. He is a demigod who has resorted to grafting body parts from other beings onto himself to compensate for his perceived weakness. He resides in Stormveil Castle and wields a massive axe that can transform into a dragon head.

title: Rennala Queen of the Full Moon
content: Rennala Queen of the Full Moon is the ruler of Raya Lucaria Academy. She is a powerful sorceress who can manipulate gravity and summon spectral beings. Defeating her allows players to respec their character's attributes, making her a crucial encounter for character customization.

title: Radahn the Starscourge
content: Radahn the Starscourge is a demigod known for his immense strength and mastery of gravity magic. He halted the movement of the stars themselves, which led to the eternal night in certain regions. His boss fight is one of the most epic in the game, requiring players to summon NPC allies to stand a chance.

title: Rykard Lord of Blasphemy
content: Rykard Lord of Blasphemy is a demigod who merged with a giant serpent. He resides in Mt. Gelmir and leads the Blasphemous Cult. His boss fight involves both human and serpent forms, with the serpent form being particularly challenging due to its size and powerful attacks.

title: Morgott the Omen King
content: Morgott the Omen King is the true ruler of Leyndell, Royal Capital. He is an Omen, a being born with horns, which led to his imprisonment in the sewers. Despite his status, he fiercely protects the Erdtree and is one of the final challenges before reaching the Elden Throne.

title: Malenia Blade of Miquella
content: Malenia Blade of Miquella is widely regarded as the hardest boss in Elden Ring. She is a demigod with unparalleled speed and skill, wielding a katana that can inflict Scarlet Rot. Her fight is a true test of patience and skill, requiring precise dodging and careful timing.

title: Classes
content: Elden Ring offers ten starting classes, each with unique starting attributes and equipment. These include Vagabond, Warrior, Hero, Bandit, Astrologer, Prophet, Prisoner, Confessor, Samurai, and Wretch. Choosing the right class can significantly impact early-game progression.

title: Weapons
content: Elden Ring features a vast array of weapons, including swords, axes, bows, staffs, and more. Each weapon has unique movesets and can be upgraded using Smithing Stones. Some weapons have special abilities known as Weapon Arts, which can be devastating in combat when used correctly.

title: Spells and Incantations
content: Magic in Elden Ring is divided into two categories: Sorceries and Incantations. Sorceries are arcane spells typically cast with staves, while Incantations are divine or faith-based spells cast with seals. Both can be learned from various NPCs throughout the game.

title: Summoning
content: Summoning allows players to call upon NPC allies or Spirit Ashes to aid them in combat. Spirit Ashes are special items that can be obtained throughout the game, each summoning a unique spirit. Some bosses require summoning to be manageable, while others become easier with the help of allies.

title: Exploration Tips
content: The Lands Between is vast and full of secrets. Always explore every corner, as hidden paths often lead to valuable items and powerful weapons. Use Torrent, the spectral steed, to traverse the landscape quickly and reach otherwise inaccessible areas.

title: Combat Tips
content: Patience is key in Elden Ring combat. Learn enemy attack patterns and wait for openings. Use your shield effectively, but don't rely on it too much—rolling is often a better defensive option. Remember to use healing flasks strategically and never underestimate the importance of positioning.

title: Elden Lord Ending
content: To become the Elden Lord, players must defeat all major demigods, collect their Great Runes, and reach the Elden Throne. The final boss fight is against the Elden Beast, a powerful entity that guards the Elden Ring. Upon victory, players can choose to mend the Elden Ring and become the new Elden Lord.

title: Alternative Endings
content: Elden Ring features multiple endings based on player choices throughout the game. These include the Age of the Stars ending, where players help Ranni achieve her goal, and the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending, which destroys the Lands Between. Each ending offers a unique perspective on the game's story.

title: Legendary Items
content: Legendary items are powerful weapons, talismans, and sorceries that are particularly rare and powerful. Collecting all legendary items is required for the 'Elden Lord' achievement. Notable legendary items include the Dark Moon Greatsword, Blasphemous Blade, and the Elden Ring itself.

title: NPC Quests
content: Elden Ring features numerous NPCs with elaborate questlines. These quests often lead to valuable rewards, new areas, and additional lore. Key NPCs include Ranni the Witch, Blaidd the Half-Wolf, Fia the Deathbed Companion, and Dung Eater.
